entities.name: 5GS forbidden tracking areas for roaming
entities.description: List maintained by UE containing tracking areas where roaming is forbidden. Managed independently per access type (3GPP or wireline).

entities.name: 5GS forbidden tracking areas for regional provision of service
entities.description: List maintained by UE containing tracking areas where regional service provision is forbidden. Managed independently per access type (3GPP or wireline).

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The mobile device that maintains and manages the forbidden tracking area lists.

entities.name: List erasure conditions
entities.description: Conditions that trigger erasure of forbidden tracking area lists: UE switch off, UICC removal, subscriber data update, or periodic erasure every 12-24 hours.

entities.name: TA removal conditions
entities.description: Conditions that remove a tracking area from forbidden lists: receiving TA in TAI list or Service area list of allowed tracking areas in REGISTRATION ACCEPT or CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND, except when registered for emergency services.

entities.name: 3GPP access update conditions
entities.description: Conditions that update forbidden lists over 3GPP access: receiving REGISTRATION REJECT, SERVICE REJECT, or DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with 5GMM causes #12, #13, #15, or receiving REGISTRATION ACCEPT/SERVICE ACCEPT with forbidden TAIs.

entities.name: Wireline access update conditions
entities.description: Conditions that update forbidden lists over wireline access: receiving REGISTRATION REJECT, SERVICE REJECT, or DEREGISTRATION REQUEST with 5GMM causes #12 or #13.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT
entities.description: NAS message that can contain allowed tracking areas, triggering removal from forbidden lists.

entities.name: CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND
entities.description: NAS message that can contain allowed tracking areas, triggering removal from forbidden lists.

entities.name: REJECT/REQUEST messages
entities.description: NAS messages including REGISTRATION REJECT, SERVICE REJECT, DEREGISTRATION REQUEST that can trigger updates to forbidden lists.

entities.name: List management properties
entities.description: Properties governing list management: capacity of 40+ TAIs, oldest entry deletion when full, independent management per access type.
